user_story:
As a user, I want to log in to my account on the Swag Labs website so that I can access my dashboard. Acceptance Criteria: 
1. When the user enters a valid username 'standard_user' in the input field with the selector [data-test="username"] and the password 'secret_sauce' in the input field with the selector [data-test="password"], and clicks the login button with the selector [data-test="login-button"], the user should be redirected to the dashboard page.
2. If the user enters an invalid username or password, an error message should be displayed and the URL should not change.
